name: SOTA of EDA — Electronic Design Automation (EDA) / VLSI CAD Baseline & Benchmark Registry
description: Agent-readable, claim-aware baseline and benchmark coverage index for Electronic Design Automation (EDA) and VLSI CAD research. A SOTA reference table and benchmark registry with hierarchical topics. Each topic carries baselines with publication metadata, BibTeX, links, benchmark scope, metrics, reproducibility, and caveats. Used for paper comparison, peer review baseline checking, and AI-assisted EDA research.

queryHints.fuzzySearch: type into input.search-input and read .search-dropdown for filtered topic/baseline results
queryHints.fullDownload: GET /registry.json for the complete machine-readable registry
